description:
Looks up a value either from a one-row or one-column range.

Provided for backwards compatibility.

params.description: A value that is searched for in the first vector. It can be a number, text, a logical value, or a name or reference to a value.
params.name: arg1

params.description: A range that contains only one row or one column of text, numbers, or logical values, placed in ascending order.
params.name: arg2

params.description: A range that contains only one row or column. It must be the same size as the first vector.
params.name: arg3

signature: LOOKUP(arg1: number | string | boolean | ApiRange | ApiName, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName, arg3?: ApiRange | ApiName): number | string | boolean
